edits.before: "A valid new job starts queued, version 0, attempts 0. It has no lease or output yet."
edits.after: "有效新任务从 queued、版本 0、尝试次数 0 开始，尚无租约或输出。"

edits.before: "The CLI binds an identifier to immutable text. Identical enqueue is safe; changed text conflicts."
edits.after: "CLI 将标识符绑定到不可变文本。内容相同的重复入队可安全处理；文本变化会冲突。"

edits.before: "Change the identifier and payload relationship to compute whether creation or redelivery is permitted."
edits.after: "改变标识符与载荷的关系，计算是否允许创建或重复投递。"
"创建 queued、版本 0 的记录；尚未执行副作用"
"已拒绝：该标识符已绑定其他文本"
"相同内容再次投递：保留已有任务"

edits.before: "The caller's expected version must equal the queued record's current version."
edits.after: "调用方的预期版本必须等于 queued 记录的当前版本。"

edits.before: "Recovery retains attempts. A queued job can still have exhausted its retry budget."
edits.after: "恢复保留尝试计数；queued 任务也可能已经耗尽重试额度。"

edits.before: "A successful transition increments version and attempts, sets expiry, then saves while the ledger lock is held."
edits.after: "转换成功时递增版本和尝试次数，设置到期时间，再于持有账本锁时保存。"

edits.before: "The lease interval is half open: expiry is the first millisecond at which completion is rejected."
edits.after: "租约区间左闭右开：到期时间就是开始拒绝完成提交的首个毫秒。"
"领取已接受；先持久化，再执行"
"达到尝试上限；保留 queued 记录"

edits.before: "Time and version independently fence a worker"
edits.after: "分别通过时间和版本限制工作进程"

edits.before: "A running worker needs both its current version and time strictly before expiry."
edits.after: "running 工作进程既须提交当前版本，也须严格早于租约到期时间。"

edits.before: "At expiry, running v1 becomes queued v2. This invalidates the old worker before another claim."
edits.after: "到期时，running v1 转为 queued v2，在下一次领取前先使旧工作进程失效。"

edits.before: "The new worker claims v3. Old v1 cannot finish, even if it reports an earlier clock."
edits.after: "新工作进程领取 v3。即使旧 v1 报告更早的时钟，也无法提交完成。"

edits.before: "Move the clock to 110 and switch the submitted version to see the two independent checks."
edits.after: "将时钟移至 110，并切换提交版本，观察两项独立检查。"
"恢复写出结果与标记完成之间的间隙"

edits.before: "After expiry, recovery reaches v3, reuses an identical receipt when present and persists completed v4."
edits.after: "租约到期后恢复至 v3，复用已有的相同凭据，并持久化 completed v4。"
